evidence.title: Sigmoid Attention as a Better Substrate for Learned KV Cache Eviction

summary: Researchers introduce Sigmoid Attention as a more effective approach for managing key-value (KV) cache eviction in transformer models, aiming to enhance memory efficiency. The method could improve performance in large language models by optimizing attention mechanisms.
title: Sigmoid Attention Proposed as Improved Method for Learned KV Cache Eviction in AI Models
